added_lines: please you tube the video message pope leo xiv has given to us for this 100th mission sunday. the annual collection will take place this weekend at all masses. parish list of the dead as we approach november, we compile our own individual list of our beloved dead and add them to the parish list of the dead 2026. the parish list of the dead envelopes are available in the churches, in your box of parish envelopes or simply write on a plain envelope parish list of the dead and enclose your name, address, offering and list of beloved dead. on friday 6th november at 7:30pm in st. colmcille’s church a special mass of memory will be offered, at which we will think especially of the parishioners whom we have buried since this time last year. we invite their families to join us for this memorial, as we recognise their grief and support them with our prayers. we also invite other parishioners who may have lost loved ones and celebrated their funerals elsewhere. please come and join with us as we pray for the gentle repose of their souls in the eternal love and mercy of god. kells

maintenance: €330; list of the dead: €60. thanks to all who are so generous. catholic newspaper on sale at the entrance for €3.80 per copy . world mission sunday: ‘one in christ, united in mission’ pope leo xiv world mission sunday is the holy father’s annual appeal for spiritual and financial support so that the life-giving work of overseas mission and missionaries can continue. it always falls on the second last sunday in october, and like the good friday collection for the holy land and peter’s pence, it is one of three annual universal church collections. world mission sunday collecti ons take place in every single parish where the church is present. this includes not only ireland and europe, but also in poorer parishes in developing countries. it is a moment of universal solidarity when each member of the church family, regardless of location or background, play their part in supporting each other. the holy father has chosen the theme ‘one in christ, united in mission’ to celebrate 100 years of world mission sunday and encourages us to unite with missionaries as they strive to reach out with god’s love to communities in need. see pope leo’s video message for world mission sunday on our parish website
